name: io.github.noahowsh/endzoneapi
title: EndzoneAPI
description: Pro football play-by-play, stats, injuries, and odds. REST API and MCP server. Free to start.

headers.name: x-api-key
headers.description: Your EndzoneAPI API key. Get a free key with 500 credits at endzoneapi.com/signup

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: All 32 teams with conference, division, colours, and logos

tools.name: get_standings
tools.description: Standings and playoff seeding by the NFL tiebreaking procedure, with the step that decided each rank

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Upcoming games by week or for the next N days

tools.name: search_players
tools.description: Find players by name, team, or position

tools.name: get_injuries
tools.description: Injury report by team and week with practice and game status

tools.name: get_games
tools.description: Query games by season, week, team, date, type, or status, with closing lines

tools.name: get_team_stats
tools.description: Team totals and per-week lines with EPA, success rate, and situational splits

tools.name: get_player_stats
tools.description: Weekly and season stat lines for one player: passing, rushing, receiving, defense, kicking, fantasy

tools.name: get_player_leaders
tools.description: Leaderboard for any stat, filtered by position, team, and season

tools.name: get_snap_counts
tools.description: Offensive, defensive, and special-teams snaps and shares by game or player

tools.name: get_advanced_stats
tools.description: Next Gen Stats tracking metrics and Pro Football Reference advanced stats

tools.name: get_plays
tools.description: Play-by-play with EPA, win probability, situation filters, and optional FTN charting

tools.name: get_odds
tools.description: Odds by game with bookmaker filters

tools.name: get_game_detail
tools.description: Full game detail with team stats, starting QBs, odds, weather, and officials

tools.name: get_head_to_head
tools.description: Matchup history with win/loss records and margins

tools.name: get_player_props
tools.description: Player prop lines by sportsbook, opening and closing
